name: player
description: Plays videos from any yt-dlp source in a pane while Claude works

source.title: Video source
source.description: Anything yt-dlp reads: a video, playlist or channel URL, or ytsearch20:<query>. Empty: nothing plays until /play <url>.

pick.title: Which video next
pick.description: newest: the source's order (a channel lists newest first); random: any of its first 20

linkPattern.title: Link pattern
linkPattern.description: For pages yt-dlp cannot list (e.g. a site's 'newest' page): a regex matching the video links on that page. Empty: off.
